# Pull Request

## 变更说明 / Description
简述本次 PR 的改动。Briefly describe the changes in this PR.

## 关联 Issue / Related issue
Closes #(issue)

## 改动类型 / Type of change
- [ ] 缺陷修复 / Bug fix
- [ ] 新功能 / New feature
- [ ] 文档 / Documentation
- [ ] 重构 / Refactor

## 自查清单 / Checklist
- [ ] 已运行 `npm test` 且全部通过 / Tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] 新增逻辑已补充或更新测试 / New logic is covered by tests
- [ ] 界面文案已同步中英文 / UI strings updated in both 中文 and English
- [ ] 已阅读 CONTRIBUTING.md / I have read CONTRIBUTING.md
